base_member_text: [L120-L129] (HIGH/parser/metadata-loss) The greedy `.*` after the optional value is followed only by optional metadata groups, so it can consume the entire remainder of every parameter declaration and prevent unit, description, and JSON metadata from being captured.
audit_member_text: [L120-L127] (MED/parser/greedy-match) The greedy wildcard after a parameter's initial value consumes the comment, unit, and description, so those named metadata groups resolve empty even for populated declarations.

adversarial.rationale: Executing the actual parameter regex in isolation reproduces unit=None, description="", and json=None for a populated declaration; all 394 current parameters also lose these fields. generate.py:175-192 performs no later metadata recovery, and the greedy remainder has no mandatory trailing metadata token that would force backtracking.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex independent skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L239-L251] (MED/generation/validation) Template rendering writes directly to the final `.inc` file with no temporary-file or atomic-replace step, so a render exception can leave a truncated generated source file.
audit_member_text: [L239-L251] (MED/generation/atomicity) Each destination is opened with truncating mode before template rendering, so a render exception can destroy the last valid generated include and leave a partial file.

adversarial.rationale: generate.py:240 loads/compiles the template before opening the destination, so template-loading errors do not truncate it, but rendering still occurs after truncation and six header writes at lines 243-250. A render-time missing metadata key therefore leaves a header-only replacement; neither the generator nor the Makefile.am:91-92 invocation provides rollback or atomic replacement.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex independent skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L112,L120] (MED/parser/grammar) The parameter grammar accepts only one comma attribute word and a whitespace-free initializer token, so otherwise valid declarations with multiple attributes or spaced expressions have an unclear or lossy parse contract.

audit_member_text: [L123] (LOW/parser/schema) The parameter-unit character class excludes slash and question-mark characters that are used by units in params.def, independently making the declared unit grammar inconsistent with its input.

[L134-L147,L201-L209] (MED/type-system/contract) The parser accepts logical, float, and complex source types and maps them to ISO types, but generation performs no capability check that the selected templates can represent those types in their introspection dispatch.

[L149-L166,L175-L192] (MED/schema/validation) Parsed declarations are accepted without checking required JSON keys, name uniqueness, or agreement between declaration rank and JSON shape rank, allowing inconsistent definition data to fail later or generate contradictory Fortran.
dispositions.rationale: span-confirmed: Both parsing loops append declarations after regex/type parsing and an optional JSON merge, without checking required metadata, duplicate names, or declaration-rank/shape consistency; the exception handlers only catch errors already raised. No validation occurs before rendering, and indextos.mako directly requires shape and broadcast and derives its pointer rank from shape, allowing missing keys to fail during rendering and inconsistent shapes to generate incompatible pointer assignments.

adversarial.rationale: The parser accepts a variable declaration without JSON and accepts mismatched dimension/shape ranks; no uniqueness or required-key validation intervenes before rendering. spacedecl.mako:7-16 uses parsed rank while index_allocate.mako:7-20 uses JSON shape, so inconsistent input can generate incompatible declarations/allocations; the 327 current variables happen to have complete keys, matching ranks, and unique names, which does not validate future input.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex independent skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

audit_member_text: [L164-L166,L190-L192] (MED/schema/integrity) Unrestricted dictionary update lets arbitrary JSON metadata overwrite parsed structural fields such as name, type, dimension, or rank.
dispositions.rationale: span-confirmed: At L164-L166 and L190-L192, json.loads results are merged directly into the parsed dictionaries after name, dimension, type, and rank have been established. There is no reserved-key restriction or subsequent restoration, so metadata keys can replace these structural fields before rendering.

adversarial.rationale: Structural overrides are reproducible for variables: JSON name and rank replace the parsed values at generate.py:165 without revalidation. The parameter half is presently unreachable because parameter_re consumes the entire comment before its optional JSON group, so parameter["json"] is None and lines 190-191 never apply such an override.

(?P<value>(=\s*[^\s]+)?)                  # value
        .*                                        # anything
        (!<?\s*)?                                 # comment
        (\[(?P<unit>[\^\w\-\._]+)\])?             # unit
        \s*                                       # space
        (?P<description>.*?)                      # description
        \s*                                       # space
        ((?P<json>\{.*\}))?                       # JSON key-value pairs
        \s*                                       # space
        $                                         # end of line

audit_member_text: [L226-L227] (LOW/build/portability) Default template discovery deliberately relies on the undocumented glob.glob1 API.

[L221-L225] (LOW/CLI/contract) Command-line template paths are reduced to basenames without validation, so the supplied directory is silently ignored and a same-named template from the fixed template directory is used.
dispositions.rationale: span-refuted: Basename stripping is present, but the nearby CLI contract at L218-L220 explicitly expects names like x.mako and says the file comes from the templates directory; the fixed TemplateLookup at L231 implements that contract. This documented name-selection interface neutralizes the alleged arbitrary-path contract violation: the source does not promise to load templates from supplied directories.

audit_member_text: [L241] (LOW/filename/derivation) Output naming replaces every occurrence of '.mako' rather than requiring it as a suffix, permitting surprising output names for malformed CLI inputs.
